ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time (price list). The hall has only 8-hour and 12-hour rates and no 24-hour rate, and night-time or 24-hour use may not be available depending on the bookings before and after, so consult in advance. Conference rooms have 4-hour, 8-hour and 12-hour rates, and use outside business hours requires separate consultation. Same-day early extension and late extension are charged per 30 minutes; under hall regular rate ① (Mon-Wed), 7:00-22:00 is 111,100 yen tax included, and 22:00 to 7:00 the next day is 126,500 yen tax included. Advance arrival of packages is in principle specified as arrival on the day before the event, and an advance load-in notice is submitted at least 1 week before the work date (valuables are not accepted, and no responsibility is taken for damage to packages). Packages received in advance are in principle limited to 5 boxes for the hall and 2 boxes per room. Large quantities of packages or large packages not notified in advance are treated as renting the venue for a fee as a storage space. (Source: Hall and Conference Room Price List, updated July 3, 2026; FAQ; Advance Load-in Notice; Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 20)
ops.loadingHours: If there is load-in or load-out, an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (the loading area cannot be used if it is not submitted). Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave from the designated place within the usage time, and the venue may adjust load-in times and the like. Loading and unloading work is in principle limited to 20 minutes. The loading area is on the 1F, and the permitted dimensions are 3,800 mm overall height x 6,600 mm overall length (as stated in the Advance Load-in Notice). The load-in/load-out elevator has an entrance door 1,100 mm wide x 2,600 mm high, inside the car 1,950 mm wide x 1,800 mm deep x 3,000 mm high, and a load capacity of 1,650 kg. The passenger elevator has an entrance door 1,100 mm wide x 2,600 mm high, inside the car 2,050 mm wide x 2,000 mm deep x 2,700 mm high, and a load capacity of 2,000 kg. The 3F hall has a back-of-house route (official facility page). The on-site supervisor completes entry procedures at the Bellesalle reception on the 4F of Sumitomo Fudosan Shinjuku Minamiguchi Building before work, and completes a completion report and exit procedures after work. The building entrance is open 7:00-21:00. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice, 3F Hall and 4F Conference Rooms equipment list updated September 11, 2026, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 16)
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is used only for loading and unloading; when parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking, parking outside the designated parking lots, and roadside parking around the building are strictly prohibited. Products, packing materials, decoration materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period, and the load-in/load-out doors are kept closed at all times. If delivery vehicle traffic is expected to be congested, traffic staff are placed at the entrance and elsewhere. The vehicle restrictions in the equipment list are height under 3,800 mm x length 6,600 mm or less, weight 2.0 t. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 15 and 16, 3F Hall and 4F Conference Rooms equipment list updated September 11, 2026)
ops.parking: In the equipment list, the parking column is "none" for Bellesalle-exclusive parking, hourly parking and vehicle drop-off alike (for both the 3F hall and the 4F conference rooms). To find nearby hourly parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Shinjuku Minamiguchi" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation, a public interest foundation), which is linked from the official facility page. (Source: Official facility page, 3F Hall and 4F Conference Rooms equipment list updated September 11, 2026)
ops.waitingRooms: There are 3 waiting rooms on the 2F (Waiting Room 1 13㎡, Waiting Room 2 12㎡, Waiting Room 3 12㎡; the 3 rooms can also be connected and used together) and a 3F waiting room for the hall (20㎡, with a hot-water space). The 2F waiting rooms are listed as paid on the conference room price list, with regular rates of 4 hours 18,700 yen tax included, 8 hours 25,300 yen tax included and 12 hours 31,900 yen tax included. On the hall's official page, "waiting room" is listed from 0 yen. Waiting rooms cannot be used on their own. (Source: Official facility page, Hall and Conference Room price list updated July 3, 2026, 3F Hall equipment list updated September 11, 2026)
ops.catering: Outside food/drink brought in is allowed. However, if a caterer other than the operator's designated vendors is used, an "outside food/drink fee" applies (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). Party menus for receptions are introduced on the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide PDF, FAQ, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 4)
